pairs.target: jìxìn guì qiánpái zhe liùgè rén .
pairs.english: Six people were queuing at the postal counter.
pairs.hanzi: 寄信柜前排着六个人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shù guò yícì , yòu shù le yícì , juéde duìwu méiyǒu wǎngqián dòng .
pairs.english: Tavi counted them once, then again, feeling the queue hadn't moved.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维数过一次，又数了一次，觉得队伍没有往前动。

pairs.target: zhàn zài zuì qiánmiàn de nánrén dàilái yíjuàn shī le biān de zhàng zhǐ , jiānchí yào xiān tānkāi , liànggān zài fēng .
pairs.english: The man at the front had brought a roll of account papers with damp edges, insisting on spreading them out to dry before sealing them.
pairs.hanzi: 站在最前面的男人带来一卷湿了边的账纸，坚持要先摊开，晾干再封。

pairs.target: guì lǐ de nǚrén shuō tā kěyǐ qù chuāng xià liàng , hòumiàn de rén háiyào jì .
pairs.english: The woman behind the counter said he could dry them by the window; people behind him needed to post things too.
pairs.hanzi: 柜里的女人说他可以去窗下晾，后面的人还要寄。

pairs.target: nánrén bú fàngxīn bǎ wèizhì ràng chūlái , zuìhòu yòng zìjǐ de màozi yā zài guì jiǎo , xiàng liúxià yìxiǎokuài lǐngdì .
pairs.english: Unwilling to trust anyone with his place, the man finally weighed down the counter's corner with his hat, like staking out a little territory.
pairs.hanzi: 男人不放心把位置让出来，最后用自己的帽子压在柜角，像留下一小块领地。

pairs.target: yīwén kànzhe nà dǐng màozi , xiǎoshēng shuō : " nǐ yě kěyǐ bǎ xié liúxià . "
pairs.english: Looking at the hat, Iven said quietly, “You could leave your shoes too.”
pairs.hanzi: 伊文看着那顶帽子，小声说：“你也可以把鞋留下。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu xiào .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't laugh.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有笑。

pairs.target: tā bǎ xìnfēng cóng dài lǐ qǔchū lái , jiǎnchá wěi jiē hé lín yuán de míngzì yǒuméiyǒu bèi cèng huā .
pairs.english: He took the envelope from his bag and checked whether Reed Steps and Lin Yuan's names had smudged.
pairs.hanzi: 他把信封从袋里取出来，检查苇阶和林沅的名字有没有被蹭花。

pairs.target: shōuxìn chù réng shì yuánlái nàge guì kǒu , xià yìchéng yóu lín yuán zhuǎnjiāo .
pairs.english: The receiving point was still the same counter; Lin Yuan would forward it on the next leg.
pairs.hanzi: 收信处仍是原来那个柜口，下一程由林沅转交。

pairs.target: tāmen zài shàng gè xiūxirì jiè dào le dì míngcè ,
pairs.english: On their last rest day they had borrowed the place-name register,
pairs.hanzi: 他们在上个休息日借到了地名册，

pairs.target: zhǎodào lù tīng jiù xiūlǐ péng suǒshǔ de héduàn , què méi zhǎodào xiànzài néng zǒu dào jiù gōngfáng de lù .
pairs.english: and found the river stretch containing Reed Reach's old repair yard, but not a current route to the old workshops.
pairs.hanzi: 找到鹭汀旧修理棚所属的河段，却没找到现在能走到旧工房的路。

pairs.target: shūshàng de xìxiàn búshì tōngxíng de bǎozhèng .
pairs.english: Fine lines in a book were no guarantee of passage.
pairs.hanzi: 书上的细线不是通行的保证。

pairs.target: zhè fēngxìn , tā gǎi le sāngè wǎnshàng .
pairs.english: He had revised this letter for three evenings.
pairs.hanzi: 这封信，他改了三个晚上。

pairs.target: zuìchū tā wèn , nà sānliàng chēlǐ shìbushì yǒu yíliàng céngjīng cáng zhe háizi .
pairs.english: At first he asked whether one of those three wagons had once concealed a child.
pairs.hanzi: 最初他问，那三辆车里是不是有一辆曾经藏着孩子。

pairs.target: xiě chūlái cái fājué , duìfāng hěn kěnéng lián chē yě méiyǒu jiàn guò .
pairs.english: Only once it was written did he realize the recipient might never even have seen the wagons.
pairs.hanzi: 写出来才发觉，对方很可能连车也没有见过。

pairs.target: hòulái tā bǎ wèntí chāikāi , xiān qǐngwèn cóngqián zài pénglǐ zuògōng de rén , yǒuméiyǒu jìde nàge dōngtiān xiàng gāochù sòngzǒu guò háizi ;
pairs.english: Later he split the question up, first asking former yard workers whether anyone remembered sending a child uphill that winter;
pairs.hanzi: 后来他把问题拆开，先请问从前在棚里做工的人，有没有记得那个冬天向高处送走过孩子；

pairs.target: ruò yǒu , zài wèn wǎng nǎtiáo lù sòng , shuí jiēguò shǒu .
pairs.english: if so, then which road they had taken, and who had received the child.
pairs.hanzi: 若有，再问往哪条路送、谁接过手。

pairs.target: méiyǒu yě qǐng zhàoshí shuō , búbì wèile huídá tā qù bǔqí bú jìde de dìfāng .
pairs.english: If not, please say so honestly; there was no need to fill gaps in memory merely to answer him.
pairs.hanzi: 没有也请照实说，不必为了回答他去补齐不记得的地方。

pairs.target: yuē shísìnián qián , dōngtiān , liǎngsānsuì .
pairs.english: About fourteen years ago; winter; two or three years old.
pairs.hanzi: 约十四年前、冬天、两三岁。

pairs.target: tā zài zhèxiē zìpáng dōu liú le yúdì .
pairs.english: He left room for uncertainty beside each phrase.
pairs.hanzi: 他在这些字旁都留了余地。

pairs.target: chē ké de cǎotú lìngfù , biāomíng xíngzhuàng láizì hòulái de huíyì , bùnéng nálái yìng rèn biānhào .
pairs.english: The wagon-shell sketch was attached separately, labelled as a shape drawn from later recollection, not a basis for forcing a serial-number match.
pairs.hanzi: 车壳的草图另附，标明形状来自后来的回忆，不能拿来硬认编号。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu xiě " wǒ de gùxiāng lù tīng ". zhī xiě " xiǎng zhǎo de rén ".
pairs.english: He didn't write “my hometown, Reed Reach.” Only “the people I hope to find.”
pairs.hanzi: 他没有写“我的故乡鹭汀”。只写“想找的人”。

pairs.target: duìwu wǎngqián nuó le liǎnggè wèizhì .
pairs.english: The queue advanced two places.
pairs.hanzi: 队伍往前挪了两个位置。

pairs.target: yīwén hūrán zhǐxiàng tā xiùkǒu , shuō mò cèng zài nàlǐ le .
pairs.english: Iven suddenly pointed at his cuff and said he'd smudged ink there.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文忽然指向他袖口，说墨蹭在那里了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi táishǒu yí kàn , cái fāxiàn búshì mò , shì zuótiān gěi mǐlā bāngmáng shí zhān shàng de hēijiāo .
pairs.english: Tavi raised his hand to look, then realized it wasn't ink but black glue from helping Mira yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维抬手一看，才发现不是墨，是昨天给米拉帮忙时沾上的黑胶。

pairs.target: mǐlā jīntiān qù le lìng yìtiáojiē de mùliào pù .
pairs.english: Mira had gone to a timber shop on another street today.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉今天去了另一条街的木料铺。

pairs.target: tāmen yuē hǎo jìwán xìn zài qiáotóu děng ,
pairs.english: They had agreed to meet at the bridge after posting the letter.
pairs.hanzi: 他们约好寄完信在桥头等，

pairs.target: tā shuō ruò yǒurén xiān è le , kěyǐ mǎi bǐng , dàn bùxǔ bǎ tā nà fèn yě chīdiào .
pairs.english: She said anyone who got hungry first could buy flatbread, but mustn't eat her share too.
pairs.hanzi: 她说若有人先饿了，可以买饼，但不许把她那份也吃掉。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yòu mō chū nài lěi de duǎnxìn .
pairs.english: Tavi took out Nerai's short letter as well.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维又摸出奈蕾的短信。

pairs.target: xìn shì qiánrì dào de , zhǐyǒu yíyè , zhé kǒulǐ jiá zhe yílì hěn xì de shā .
pairs.english: It had arrived the day before yesterday, just one page, with a very fine grain of sand caught in the fold.
pairs.hanzi: 信是前日到的，只有一页，折口里夹着一粒很细的砂。

pairs.target: tā méishěde dǒudiào .
pairs.english: He hadn't had the heart to shake it out.
pairs.hanzi: 他没舍得抖掉。

pairs.target: běi chà de ràoxíng pō duàn yòu liáng le liǎngchù ,
pairs.english: They had measured two more spots on Northfork's detour slope;
pairs.hanzi: 北汊的绕行坡段又量了两处，

pairs.target: yǎ lì dài rén bǎ kūshuǐ shí xiūchuán yào zhàn de dìfāng yě zhǐchū lái le .
pairs.english: Yali had brought people to point out the space boat repairs would occupy at low water too.
pairs.hanzi: 雅栗带人把枯水时修船要占的地方也指出来了。

pairs.target: yǒu yíduàn kànzhe gòu kuān , zhuǎnyùn de cháng mù què guò bùliǎo wān , xūyào lìng suàn .
pairs.english: One stretch looked wide enough, but long timbers being transported couldn't round its bend; it needed further calculation.
pairs.hanzi: 有一段看着够宽，转运的长木却过不了弯，需要另算。

pairs.target: huòyùn de shìqíng réng zài yì , nài lěi méiyǒu gěi huíchéng de rìzi .
pairs.english: Freight was still under discussion, and Nerai gave no date for returning to the city.
pairs.hanzi: 货运的事情仍在议，奈蕾没有给回城的日子。

pairs.target: mòwěi què búshì cèliáng .
pairs.english: But the ending wasn't about surveying.
pairs.hanzi: 末尾却不是测量。

pairs.target: tā xiě yèlǐ jièsù de wūdǐng lòushuǐ ,
pairs.english: She wrote that the roof of their night's lodging leaked.
pairs.hanzi: 她写夜里借宿的屋顶漏水，

pairs.target: hè shīfu bǎ zìjǐ de pén nuó le sānhuí , zuìhòu zhàn qǐlái shuō yào qù zhǎo yìjiān búxiàyǔ de wūzi ,
pairs.english: Master He moved his basin three times, then finally stood up and declared he was going to find a room where it didn't rain,
pairs.hanzi: 贺师傅把自己的盆挪了三回，最后站起来说要去找一间不下雨的屋子，

pairs.target: bèi wūzhǔ wèn shìbushì xiǎng shuì jīshè .
pairs.english: only for the householder to ask whether he wanted to sleep in the chicken coop.
pairs.hanzi: 被屋主问是不是想睡鸡舍。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàndào zhèlǐ , zhōngyú xiào le .
pairs.english: Tavi finally laughed when he got to that part.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看到这里，终于笑了。

pairs.target: yīwén còu guòlái kàn , tā bǎ xìn dìguòqù , xiān zhǐmíng nà yíduàn .
pairs.english: Iven leaned over to see, and he handed him the letter, pointing out that paragraph first.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文凑过来看，他把信递过去，先指明那一段。

pairs.target: yīwén dúwán , shuō zhè bǐ bàngōngshì lǐ de huíbào hǎokàn duō le .
pairs.english: After reading it, Iven said it was much more entertaining than the office reports.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文读完，说这比办公室里的回报好看多了。

pairs.target: lún dào tǎ wéi shí , guì lǐ de nǚrén jiēguò xìn , wèn fùyè jǐzhāng .
pairs.english: When it was Tavi's turn, the woman took his letter and asked how many attached sheets there were.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到塔维时，柜里的女人接过信，问附页几张。

pairs.target: tā dáchūlái , děng tā kǔnhǎo wài fēng , jìxià qùchù , bǎ shōutiáo tuī gěi tā .
pairs.english: He answered and waited as she tied the outer wrapper, recorded its destination and pushed the receipt toward him.
pairs.hanzi: 他答出来，等她捆好外封、记下去处，把收条推给他。

pairs.target: tā de shǒu xuán zài guì yán shàng , rěnzhù le zài chāi yícì de niàntou .
pairs.english: His hand hovered over the counter's edge; he resisted the urge to open it once more.
pairs.hanzi: 他的手悬在柜沿上，忍住了再拆一次的念头。

pairs.target: guì hòu de rén yǐjīng zài hǎn xià yíwèi .
pairs.english: The person behind the counter was already calling the next customer.
pairs.hanzi: 柜后的人已经在喊下一位。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ shōutiáo jiá jìn shū lǐ , zǒuchū mén , yángguāng zhào dé tā mī le mīyǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi slipped the receipt into his book and walked outside, squinting in the sunlight.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把收条夹进书里，走出门，阳光照得他眯了眯眼。

pairs.target: zhè huíxìn quèshí zǒu le . tā hái liúzài zhèlǐ .
pairs.english: This time the letter had truly gone. He was still here.
pairs.hanzi: 这回信确实走了。他还留在这里。

pairs.target: qiáotóu nà jiā bǐng tān huàn le xīn tiěpán , bǐng dǐ lào dé báocuì .
pairs.english: The flatbread stall by the bridge had a new iron griddle, which baked thin, crisp bases.
pairs.hanzi: 桥头那家饼摊换了新铁盘，饼底烙得薄脆。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǐ tāmen xiān dào , shǒulǐ liǎngkuài bǐng , qízhōng yíkuài yǐjīng quē le yìkǒu .
pairs.english: Mira had arrived before them, holding two flatbreads, one already missing a bite.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉比他们先到，手里两块饼，其中一块已经缺了一口。

pairs.target: " wǒ děng è le . " tā shuō , háowú qiànyì .
pairs.english: “I got hungry waiting,” she said, utterly unapologetic.
pairs.hanzi: “我等饿了。”她说，毫无歉意。

pairs.target: tā bǎ jiàowánzhěng de nà kuài dìgěi tǎ wéi , yòu cóng dài lǐ náchū fùqīn jìhuí de gōuqú tú .
pairs.english: She handed Tavi the more intact one, then took from her bag the ditch plan her father had sent back.
pairs.hanzi: 她把较完整的那块递给塔维，又从袋里拿出父亲寄回的沟渠图。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènde nàge yìzhí méi nòng míngbái de wān .
pairs.english: Tavi recognized the bend they hadn't yet understood.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认得那个一直没弄明白的弯。

pairs.target: fùqīn zhōngyú zài pángbiān bǔ le jǐháng : wān nèi de lǎo shù bùnéng suíbiàn wā ,
pairs.english: Her father had finally added a few lines: the old tree inside the bend couldn't simply be dug up,
pairs.hanzi: 父亲终于在旁边补了几行：弯内的老树不能随便挖，

pairs.target: shù xià yǒu jǐhù rén gòngyòng de yǐnshuǐ kǒu ;
pairs.english: since several households shared a water intake beneath it.
pairs.hanzi: 树下有几户人共用的引水口；

pairs.target: jiùyuē bǎ lúnliú qǔshuǐ de dìfāng dìng zài nàlǐ , zhí gōu huì bǎ shuǐ xiān dàidào xiàyóu qù .
pairs.english: An old agreement fixed that as the place for drawing water in turn; a straight ditch would carry water downstream first.
pairs.hanzi: 旧约把轮流取水的地方定在那里，直沟会把水先带到下游去。

pairs.target: " wǒ wèn de shì pōdù , tā huí wǒ bànyè shuí gēn shuí chǎoguò jià . " mǐlā shuō .
pairs.english: “I asked about gradient, and he sent half a page on who argued with whom,” Mira said.
pairs.hanzi: “我问的是坡度，他回我半页谁跟谁吵过架。”米拉说。

pairs.target: yīwén jiēguò tú , kàn le kàn . " yě suàn huídá . "
pairs.english: Iven took the plan and looked. “Still an answer.”
pairs.hanzi: 伊文接过图，看了看。“也算回答。”

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào . kě jiù gōu měinián dōu dǔ ,
pairs.english: “I know. But the old ditch blocks every year.
pairs.hanzi: “我知道。可旧沟每年都堵，

pairs.target: yě bùnéng yīnwèi dàjiā yǐqián chǎoguò , jiù yìzhí ràng tā dǔ . "
pairs.english: You can't just let it keep blocking because people argued once.”
pairs.hanzi: 也不能因为大家以前吵过，就一直让它堵。”

pairs.target: tā yòng zhǐjiān diǎnzháo wān qián jiào kuān de yíduàn , xiǎng shì yígè néng chāixǐ de chén shā cáo ,
pairs.english: She pointed to a wider stretch before the bend; she wanted to try a removable sediment trap,
pairs.hanzi: 她用指尖点着弯前较宽的一段，想试一个能拆洗的沉沙槽，

pairs.target: hái méiyǒu suàn wán huì zhàn duōshǎo dì .
pairs.english: but hadn't yet finished calculating how much space it would occupy.
pairs.hanzi: 还没有算完会占多少地。

pairs.target: fùqīn shuō kěyǐ bǎ tú jì huíqù gěi yòngshuǐ de rén kàn , méi shuō yídìng néng zuò .
pairs.english: Her father said she could send the drawing back for the water users to see, not that it could definitely be built.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲说可以把图寄回去给用水的人看，没说一定能做。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ bǐng bāikāi , gěi tā ràngchū qiáolán shàng yíkuài gānjìng dìfāng .
pairs.english: Tavi broke his flatbread and made a clean space for her on the bridge parapet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把饼掰开，给她让出桥栏上一块干净地方。

pairs.target: mǐlā yā zhe zhǐ , yīwén zhàn dào shàngfēng chù dǎngzhù fēng .
pairs.english: Mira held the paper down, while Iven stood upwind to shield it.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉压着纸，伊文站到上风处挡住风。

pairs.target: tāmen méiyǒu gōngjù , zhǐhǎo yòng sānkē bǐngxiè dāng shù , gōukǒu hé xīn cáo .
pairs.english: With no tools, they had to use three crumbs for the tree, the ditch mouth and the new trap.
pairs.hanzi: 他们没有工具，只好用三颗饼屑当树、沟口和新槽。

pairs.target: zuìdà nà kē bèi yìzhī niǎo diāo zǒu le .
pairs.english: A bird carried off the largest crumb.
pairs.hanzi: 最大那颗被一只鸟叼走了。

pairs.target: mǐlā dèng zhe niǎo , yīwén shuō shù méi le , wèntí jiějué .
pairs.english: Mira glared at the bird. Iven said the tree was gone, problem solved.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉瞪着鸟，伊文说树没了，问题解决。

pairs.target: tā tái zhǒu zhuàng le tā yíxià .
pairs.english: She nudged him with her elbow.
pairs.hanzi: 她抬肘撞了他一下。

pairs.target: huí xuégōng shí , tāmen zài gàoshìbǎn qián tíngzhù .
pairs.english: Back at the academy, they stopped before the noticeboard.
pairs.hanzi: 回学宫时，他们在告示板前停住。

pairs.target: xià yìlún wàichǎng jiànxí kāishǐ shōu yìxiàng , cèhuì , lùjī , jiù gòujiàn cháyàn fēnliè sān lán ,
pairs.english: Expressions of interest were opening for the next round of field placements, with surveying, road foundations and old-component inspection in three columns;
pairs.hanzi: 下一轮外场见习开始收意向，测绘、路基、旧构件查验分列三栏，

pairs.target: néngfǒu cānjiā háiyào yóu gèkè lǎoshī hédìng .
pairs.english: participation still required each course teacher's approval.
pairs.hanzi: 能否参加还要由各课老师核定。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de mùguāng zài dìsān lán tíng le hěn jiǔ .
pairs.english: Tavi's eyes lingered on the third column.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的目光在第三栏停了很久。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhǎo zhǐ jì lùjī nà lán de rìqī ,
pairs.english: Mira found paper to note the road-foundations date,
pairs.hanzi: 米拉找纸记路基那栏的日期，

pairs.target: yīwén què fāxiàn cèhuì shuōmínghuì hé héchàng páiliàn zhuàng le shíchén , zhàn zài nàlǐ hěn bùtǐmiàndì tànqì .
pairs.english: while Iven discovered the surveying briefing clashed with choir practice, and stood there sighing most undignifiedly.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文却发现测绘说明会和合唱排练撞了时辰，站在那里很不体面地叹气。

pairs.target: sāngè rén méiyǒu zǒuxiàng tóng yìzhāng bàomíng zhuō .
pairs.english: The three didn't head for the same registration desk.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人没有走向同一张报名桌。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān qù jièshūchù hái dì míngcè ,
pairs.english: Tavi went first to return the place-name register to the library;
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先去借书处还地名册，

pairs.target: zǒu dào ménbiān , tīngjiàn mǐlā zài shēnhòu hǎn tā wǎnfàn liú gè wèi .
pairs.english: at the door he heard Mira call from behind him to save her a place at supper.
pairs.hanzi: 走到门边，听见米拉在身后喊他晚饭留个位。

pairs.target: tā huítóu yìng le yìshēng .
pairs.english: He turned and called back.
pairs.hanzi: 他回头应了一声。

pairs.target: shūyè lǐ jiá zhe jìxìn shōutiáo , zǒudòng shí lùchū yìjiǎo .
pairs.english: The postal receipt lay between the pages, a corner showing as he walked.
pairs.hanzi: 书页里夹着寄信收条，走动时露出一角。

pairs.target: tā bǎ tā tuīhuíqù , bào wěn le shū .
pairs.english: He pushed it back in and held the book securely.
pairs.hanzi: 他把它推回去，抱稳了书。
